'''Nobutoshi Canna''' (Japanese: '''神奈延年''' ''Kanna Nobutoshi'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Canna was born as '''Nobutoshi Hayashi''' on June 10, 1968 in {{wp|Shinagawa}}, {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actor and singer as an adult. Canna joined {{aniseries|PTS}} during {{aniseries|GS}}, where he voiced several [[Character of the day|characters of the day]]. He then returned during {{aniseries|DP}}, where he voiced a few {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}. Canna is currently affiliated with the talent agency {{wp|Aoni Production}}.
